verses.html: 33 Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.

verses.html: 34 It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.

verses.html: 35 Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.

verses.html: 32 However, as for when {I will return to this world}, no human being knows that. The angels who dwell in heaven do not know that. Even I, the Son, do not know that. Only God my Father knows that.
verses.text: 32 However, as for when {I will return to this world}, no human being knows that. The angels who dwell in heaven do not know that. Even I, the Son, do not know that. Only God my Father knows that.

verses.html: 33 So, you do not know at what moment I will return to this world. Because of that, you need to make sure that you are ready. You need to focus and pray.
verses.text: 33 So, you do not know at what moment I will return to this world. Because of that, you need to make sure that you are ready. You need to focus and pray.

verses.html: 34 {Here is a story} that illustrates {what I mean}. A man decided to travel to a different country. Before he left home, he authorized each of his servants to do something specific {to manage the household}. Then, he told the man who guarded the house to be ready {for him to return}.
verses.text: 34 {Here is a story} that illustrates {what I mean}. A man decided to travel to a different country. Before he left home, he authorized each of his servants to do something specific {to manage the household}. Then, he told the man who guarded the house to be ready {for him to return}.

verses.html: 35 So then, I am like the man who owned that house. You cannot know at what moment I will return {to this world}. It might be at sunset or at midnight. It might be very early in the morning or after sunrise. Because of that, you need to be ready {at all times}.

verses.html: 36 Otherwise, when I return {to this world} when you do not expect me, I might discover that you are not ready {for me}.

verses.html: 37 I am telling you that you need to be ready {at all times}. In fact, I am telling that to all people!”
